editorial.blurb: Elske is a Michelin-starred American restaurant where each meticulously prepared course tells a story, served by the chefs who created it in an elegant yet welcoming atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Request the tasting menu at your own pace—the kitchen is flexible and will work with you if you need to slow down between courses; service shines when you feel unhurried.

topDishes.note: a standout with incredible and unique flavors
flawless and a perfect finish to the meal
